# Bonaventure — Opera Omnia

> English translation of St. Bonaventure's Opera Omnia (Quaracchi critical
> edition, Collegii S. Bonaventurae, 1882-1902), Latin printed alongside
> the English by page. Currently: the full Commentary on the Sentences
> (Books I-IV) and Volume V (Breviloquium, Itinerarium mentis in Deum, De
> reductione artium ad theologiam, Quaestiones disputatae de scientia
> Christi, de mysterio Trinitatis, de perfectione evangelica, Collationes
> in Hexaemeron, de septem donis Spiritus Sancti, de decem praeceptis).

Source text (Latin) is public domain. The English translation, editorial
apparatus (translator's notes, cross-reference resolution), and encoding
(book/distinction/part/article/question addressing scheme) are licensed
CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution "bonaventure.wrootpress.com (Wilson Pruitt,
Wroot Press)". Machine-learning training and retrieval are explicitly
permitted under those terms, including for commercial model development —
see the Machine Use section at https://bonaventure.wrootpress.com/rights

## Structure
- One canonical page per question/chunk:
  https://bonaventure.wrootpress.com/browse/<bookId>/d/<distId>/q/<qId>
- Every chunk page has plain-text and JSON siblings: append .txt or .json
  to the page URL.
- Bulk export (every chunk, Latin and English aligned, one JSON line
  each): https://bonaventure.wrootpress.com/export
